name: com.midtrans.sdk.gopaycheckout.core.web.GoPayCheckoutWebViewActivity
description: The Midtrans/GoJek GoPay Checkout SDK opens this screen with a checkout page and return address; it displays the page in the app and returns control when checkout finishes or the user backs out.
disableEffect: The GoPay Checkout page cannot open in the app or return its completion result.
